case_dimensions.name: operation
case_dimensions.why: Different inverse relationships and regrouping logic.

case_dimensions.name: operand_1_digits
case_dimensions.note: Open-ended: the taxonomy writes the values as '1, 2, 3, 4, ..., N'. Any positive integer is legal; 1 to 4 is what the ladder reaches today.

case_dimensions.name: operand_order
case_dimensions.why: For addition, commutativity does not remove the diagnostic value of order.

case_dimensions.name: presentation
case_dimensions.why: Horizontal questions also test conversion and place-value alignment.
case_dimensions.note: assess/tags.py derives only VERTICAL and HORIZONTAL today. STORY and EQUATION_BALANCE are legal values with no generator behind them yet, so no coverage target uses them.

case_dimensions.name: alignment_required
case_dimensions.why: A learner can know the arithmetic but still fail because the shorter number is placed under the wrong column.

case_dimensions.name: regrouping
case_dimensions.why: Separates basic calculation from carry/borrow proficiency.

case_dimensions.name: regroup_columns
case_dimensions.why: A child may succeed in one column but not another.
case_dimensions.note: Open-ended, and the one dimension whose stored shape differs from its allowed values: assess/tags.py emits a list of column indices counting from 0 at the ones. No coverage target uses this dimension until the report agrees on one representation.

case_dimensions.name: regroup_pattern
case_dimensions.why: Different carry/borrow chains expose different misconceptions.
case_dimensions.note: assess/tags.py also emits NONE when no column regroups; that case is carried by regrouping = NONE.

case_dimensions.name: answer_digit_change
case_dimensions.why: Tests whether the learner anticipates magnitude changes.
case_dimensions.note: assess/tags.py derives SAME, +1 and -1 today; -MULTIPLE and ZERO are legal and unreachable from the current generators, so no coverage target uses them.

case_dimensions.name: num_operands
case_dimensions.why: Three or more addends in the same column can produce a carry greater than 1.
case_dimensions.source: taxonomy section 12; why from sections 2.8 and 5.1
case_dimensions.note: assess/tags.py emits the integer count, so a four-addend item reads 4, not '4+'.

case_dimensions.name: unknown_type
case_dimensions.why: Separates direct computation from reverse reasoning.

case_dimensions.name: unknown_position
case_dimensions.why: Where the blank sits changes the reasoning demand: a missing difference is direct calculation, a missing subtrahend or minuend is inverse reasoning.

case_dimensions.name: reasoning_type
case_dimensions.why: Measures calculation, application and reasoning separately.

case_dimensions.name: strategy
case_dimensions.why: Measures strategy choice, not only whether the final answer is correct.

case_dimensions.name: context
case_dimensions.why: Application and operation selection: the operation must be inferred from the situation, not from one keyword.
case_dimensions.source: taxonomy section 12; why from sections 10 and 10.2

case_dimensions.name: word_structure
case_dimensions.why: The eleven one-step structures of section 10.1. On identical numbers, 'had some, gave away 13, now 24' is far harder than 'had 37, gave away 13', so the structure is the case, not the arithmetic.
case_dimensions.source: taxonomy section 10.1; added by SPEC section 3.2 as the eighteenth dimension
case_dimensions.note: The only dimension no generator tags yet: word_1step and word_2step emit no structure, so no coverage target uses it. The first target belongs at R8 once the word generators carry it.
